items.title: How Did Interstellar Become Every Dude's Favorite Movie?
items.why: Patrick Willems looks at why Christopher Nolan's Interstellar, which the description calls his biggest disappointment, became one of his most beloved films. From the channel behind your Interstellar touchstone.

items.title: A Soundsystem Made From Junk...How much was it??
items.why: Laura Kampf shows her finished junk-built sound system, Club Scheisse, and how much it cost her to make.

items.title: Riding Every Era of Bikes for 150 Miles
items.why: The Speeed crew rides 150 miles of the Great Allegheny Passage from Pittsburgh to Cumberland, on bikes from the 1880s through a modern Specialized gravel bike.

items.title: Jungle: Tiny Desk Concert
items.why: Jungle plays a continuous Tiny Desk set of more than half a dozen songs, including Beat 54 into Dominoes, Keep Me Satisfied and Back on 74.

items.title: Hariguem Zaboy - Full Performance (Live on KEXP)
items.why: Thai band Hariguem Zaboy performs five songs live at Puri Bhagawan in Bali for KEXP, recorded August 29, 2026.

items.title: FM-1: Amazing things are happening with this little synth
items.why: David Hilowitz demonstrates the FM-1 synth and the firmware he is using with it.
